description.en-US: Fetch an HTTP(S) page body (size-capped, timeout-capped)
description.zh-CN: 抓取 HTTP(S) 页面正文（限长、限超时）

tools.description: Fetch a URL over HTTP GET and return the response body as text. Only http/https. Returns {url, status, content_type, truncated, body}; body is capped at max_bytes (default 256KiB). HTTP error statuses (4xx/5xx) are returned as data, not failures. Private/loopback/link-local hosts are refused by the SSRF guard and redirects are not followed. Performs an outbound network request to the target host (the visit shows up in its server logs; the URL may carry sensitive tokens) — classified Irreversible, so approval follows the session's permission mode; it is not a read-only lookup.
tools.name: fetch
